name: bk_exp09_gain_ratio
title: For line position, Oracle Lens's continuation moves one-for-one with the model's own newline decision
caption: Pilot (excluded from main analysis), layer 42, 80 fresh items per set (random directions pooled over 160). Left: each activation is pushed +/- along a direction (centred, 0.108 of its norm); x is the shift in the model's own next-token log-odds, y the shift in Oracle Lens's matching continuation (first bullet, e.g. newline vs 'the'); 95% item-bootstrap CIs. Line position sits on the identity line, raw and J-removed; tense and random directions are amplified 1.7-3.4x, and tense J-removed moves Oracle Lens while the model does not. Right: the same pushes at the q90 dose with the adapter off give chance (95% item bootstrap). Read as re-instatement of the model's newline decision, not verbalised line position; the pre-registered rule was inconclusive.
